versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the alter-my-standing skill.
- Quickly check your ~alter account's current capabilities, trust tier, and remaining privacy budget.
- Diagnose failures for calls made with your key, including validity, scopes, and expiry.
- View your handle, summary, and detailed activity/standing portfolio.
- Trigger phrases include: "who am I on alter", "is my alter key still valid", "what is my trust tier", "why did my alter call fail".
